To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.
Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify.
Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.
If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.
After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.
